answer: By the terrace of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, capped per identity per epoch, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. A copper of per-task receipts records who did what, and the grove of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
